title: Cynara scolymus tea for medicinal use
intro: Cynara scolymus tea is a herbal preparation made from the leaves of the artichoke plant, known for its bitter taste and numerous health benefits. It is commonly used in herbalism to support liver function and promote detoxification by stimulating the production of bile. This tea is also valued for its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve digestion. In traditional medicine, it has been used to treat digestive disorders and support overall metabolic health. Its versatility makes it a popular choice in both modern and traditional herbal practices.
